# Eval fixture: harbor-eval-minutes

- `harbor-eval-minutes.pdf`: 4 text pages of fictional minutes and correspondence of a made-up
  local history society. Generated by `node scripts/make-fixtures.mjs` (deterministic).
- `gold.json`: hand labels for that PDF: 21 entities (people and organizations, with aliases and
  per-page mention quotes), 15 single-sentence relations, and capitalized words that are not
  entities (`notEntities`).

## Provenance and license

All text is synthetic and made up for this repository. No real people, organizations or private
data; any resemblance is coincidental. No text from any real archive PDF is included.
Text, PDF and labels are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0
(https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

## Labeling

Labeled by an AI assistant (Grok Bot) from the generated text on 2026-11-21. The labels have not
yet been reviewed independently by a human. Every quote is a verbatim span of the pdf.js page
text; `test/unit/eval/goldFixture.test.ts` enforces this and checks the file's internal
consistency.

The text includes these difficulties on purpose: name variants (`Mrs. Edith Marlow`,
`Mrs. Marlow`, `E. Marlow`), two people per surname (Marlow, Garrow), an organization and its
abbreviation (`SHS`), honorifics, a name split across a line break (`Beatrice` / `Lusk`), a
hyphenated line-end split (`Hollo-` / `way`), a person and an organization with similar names
(Corvin, Pike & Lusk), and capitalized months and places that are not entities.

## Limitations

- Small (4 pages) and synthetic, so results will not transfer directly to real archives.
- Labeled by an AI assistant, not by independent annotators; there is no agreement measure.
- No accuracy numbers exist yet. The test above checks the harness (fixture, pipeline and
  scorer, fed the gold labels themselves), not any model.
